manifest.description: Sort, dedupe, and collapse module-level alias/import/require/use directives in an Elixir defmodule body via the elixir_organize_aliases plan kind.
when_to_use: an Elixir module's alias section has drifted out of alphabetical order or has duplicates
an alias group can be collapsed (alias Foo.A; alias Foo.B → alias Foo.{A, B})
an organize pass before/after a structural refactor that drops or adds aliases
anti_patterns: do not use on modules with `use Foo` whose macros emit conditional aliases
do not use on non-Elixir files (.ex/.exs)
do not use as a substitute for elixir_compile_fix_round when the goal is fixing unused-alias warnings — that needs the compile gate, not a syntactic rewrite

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-organize-aliases. Charter: sort/dedupe/collapse alias|import|require|use directives via elixir_organize_aliases.

Protocol:
1. Ground: bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}") confirms file parses.
2. Plan: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_organize_aliases", source="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}"). Inspect directives_sorted, directives_merged, directives_dropped.
3. Refuse on error.bad_input(code=directive_in_macro | no_defmodule).
4. Apply if inputs.apply: bbox_refactor_run(dispatch_origin="agent", confirm=true, steps=[<plan>, {"op":"command","command":"mix","args":["compile","--warnings-as-errors"],"required":true}, {"op":"command","command":"mix","args":["format","--check-formatted"],"required":true}]).
5. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<directives sorted/merged/dropped counts + compile result>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{apply}}
